text: In pride and arrogance the wicked hotly pursue and persecute the afflicted; Let them be caught in the plots which they have devised.
The wicked, in the haughtiness of his face, will not seek nor inquire for Him; All his thoughts are, "There is no God [so there is no accountability or punishment]."
He says to himself, "God has [quite] forgotten; He has hidden His face; He will never see my deed."
Break the arm of the wicked and the evildoer, Seek out his wickedness until You find no more.
To vindicate and obtain justice for the fatherless and the oppressed, So that man who is of the earth will no longer terrify them.
